name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2026-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.76 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
